name: Zhejiang Juli Culture Development Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Juli Culture Development Co.,Ltd. specializes in the comprehensive process of researching, developing, designing, manufacturing, and distributing a variety of decorative materials, serving both domestic Chinese and international markets. Its product offerings include diverse types of decorative paper, advanced high-performance decorative boards, and PVC decorative films, particularly for furniture and flooring applications, which are marketed under the "Dilong" brand. Established in Hangzhou, China, in 2000, the company operated as Zhejiang Dilong Culture Development Co., Ltd. until October 2018, when it officially adopted its current name.
